source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
With **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), these parts of the battlefield lie in [your army's Shadow of Chaos](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos):

- your deployment zone, always
- No Man's Land, for the rest of any phase that begins with you controlling half or more of the [objective markers](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) there
- the deployment zone of your opponent, for the rest of any phase that begins with you controlling half or more of the objective markers there

**DAEMONIC MANIFESTATION**: whenever a **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** unit of yours in your army's Shadow of Chaos rolls for [Battle-shock](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), the roll gets +1. If it passes, one of the unit's models **heals** D3 wounds; for a **BATTLELINE** unit, as many as D3 **destroyed** models, not **CHARACTER** models, can return to it instead.

**DAEMONIC TERROR**: whenever an enemy unit tests for Battle-shock while in your army's Shadow of Chaos, or while up to 6" from any of your **BLOODTHIRSTER**, **SKARBRAND**, **LORD OF CHANGE**, **KAIROS FATEWEAVER**, **GREAT UNCLEAN ONE**, **ROTIGUS**, **KEEPER OF SECRETS** or **SHALAXI HELBANE** units, the test gets -1, and if it fails, the enemy unit takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds).
